question: After removing any duplicate records from the rev_transactions dataset, identify each channel grouping that has transactions from more than one country. For each such channel grouping, find the country with the highest total number of transactions and report both the country name and the sum of transactions for that channel grouping.
sql:
WITH deduped AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    channelGrouping,
    geoNetwork_country,
    totals_transactions
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hits_time) as rn
    FROM `data-to-insights.ecommerce.rev_transactions`
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
country_channel_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    channelGrouping,
    geoNetwork_country,
    SUM(totals_transactions) as total_transactions
  FROM deduped
  GROUP BY channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country
),
channel_country_count AS (
  SELECT 
    channelGrouping,
    COUNT(DISTINCT geoNetwork_country) as country_count
  FROM country_channel_agg
  GROUP BY channelGrouping
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT geoNetwork_country) > 1
)
SELECT 
  cca.channelGrouping,
  cca.geoNetwork_country,
  cca.total_transactions
FROM country_channel_agg cca
INNER JOIN channel_country_count ccc ON cca.channelGrouping = ccc.channelGrouping
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cca.channelGrouping ORDER BY cca.total_transactions DESC) = 1
ORDER BY cca.channelGrouping
